page_note: 这一页是关于人员增长（Headcount growth）的报告页，左侧为正文段落与一张五年折线图，右侧为按成熟度等级分组的柱状图（带植物生长图示）以及一个问答式文字框。

heading.title: Headcount growth across maturity levels
heading.subtitle: In the hunt for the best talent, mature companies manage to find and attract the people they need

components.evidence: bars sit on a baseline with category names only; no ticks or value axis drawn
line over year labels 2017-2021, no y ticks or gridlines anywhere
"7.0%", "7.8%", "9.0%", "13.4%", "15.4%" printed in white inside each teal bar
"9.2%", "7.7%", "9.0%", "5.5%", "9.1%" printed above or beside each circle marker
the whole chart block sits on a light grey filled rectangle
seed, sprout, seedling, bud and sunflower drawn above each bar as growth-stage pictograms
left column paragraphs "The job market was hotter than ever..." run beside the right-hand grey chart panel
two separately captioned charts: "Headcount growth across maturity levels" and "5 years of bumpy headcount growth:"
"Institutionalised" label is long and set in small type under its bar

new_components.name: pictogram_growth_metaphor_over_bars
new_components.evidence: plant-growth illustrations of increasing size drawn above bars, decorative but ordered with categories
new_components.why_it_matters: 图示高度并非数据编码，读者可能误以为植物高度代表数值；实际数值只能从柱内印刷标签读取。

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure_bold_lead_in_title
new_components.evidence: "5 years of bumpy headcount growth:" set in bold body text with a colon, no figure number
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题以正文粗体行出现且无编号，解析后表格需靠这行粗体文字来定位数据行的上下文。

new_components.name: percent_unit_only_in_value_labels
new_components.evidence: no axis or heading gives a unit; "%" appears only inside labels like "13.4%"
new_components.why_it_matters: 单位信息只寄生在数值标签里，若解析器剥离百分号，数值将失去尺度依据。

spot_checks.mark: the 2020 point, the trough of the line
the 2021 end point of the line
the Initiated bar, shortest bar at left
the Institutionalised bar, fourth from left

difficulty_notes: 两张图的数值都印在图上（7.0%…15.4%、9.2%…9.1%），读数不成问题（第2步无风险）；每个值只需两个键（图标题＋类别/年份），表格容易承载（第3步也不难）。真正卡住的是上下文：两图都没有图号，f1 的标题"Headcount growth across maturity levels"和副标题以灰底框内的小号粗体出现，f2 的标题"5 years of bumpy headcount growth:"只是正文粗体一行，解析器很可能把它们并入正文段落，导致 9.1%（同时出现在正文"9.1% in 2021"里）与 f1 的 9.0% 无法区分归属；另外页面顶部大标题"Headcount growth"与 f1 标题近乎同名，进一步混淆归属。

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_in_axis_or_title 的反面情形：单位只存在于数值标签（对应 new_components 的 percent_unit_only_in_value_labels）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中的 unit_position 增加 "labels_only" 取值，并允许 value_axis_ticks 为空
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位位置=仅在数值标签 vs 在标题/轴，比较数值尺度还原准确率

suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录字段：figure_number 允许为空，title 渲染为正文粗体一行且置于绘图区上方
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有图号标题 vs 无图号粗体标题，测量导出表格能否绑定正确图上下文

suggestions.what_to_add: no_value_axis 且全部数值内嵌（value_label_inside + value_label_outside 并存于同页）
suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中加入"无值轴"配置，标签位置按图分别设为 inside / outside
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有刻度轴 vs 无轴仅标签，比较读值召回与标签位置解析

suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段加入 category_axis_icons 与 decorative_overlay 开关
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 类别轴带图示 vs 纯文字，测量类别名抽取错误率

suggestions.what_to_add: 同页多图且正文与图并列（multi_figure_page + side_text_bullets）
suggestions.where_to_change: 整页 markdown 导出条件行：一页两张无编号图＋左侧文字栏
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单图页 vs 双无编号图页，检验标题—表格配对是否串图
